profile_text.body:
Cisco is a publicly traded worldwide technology company (NASDAQ: CSCO, CIK 0000858877) that describes itself as a leader in AI infrastructure, secure networking, and software solutions. Its site positions the company as serving enterprises, hyperscalers, service providers, and data centers, with an emphasis on networking hardware built around purpose-built programmable silicon optimized for AI workloads, data center modernization, and security embedded at every layer of the network. The company also highlights autonomous network operations driven by policy-bound agents that execute workflows at machine speed while humans govern intent, policy, and risk.

On the AI product side, Cisco offers Cisco Webex AI, a meeting intelligence platform with real-time translation, noise removal, and enterprise security features. The company also operates Cisco IQ, described on its site as a unified AI-powered experience delivering real-time insights, troubleshooting, automation, and agent-driven guidance for Cisco support and professional services. The site additionally notes that the McLaren Mastercard Formula 1 Team uses Cisco networking and security for AI workloads that process race data across 24 races worldwide.

No litigation or MCP registry entries are recorded in the held facts for Cisco at this time.
